# DTI application

The paper's application (`analysis/dti-application-case.R` → `summaries/dti-case/`): right
corticospinal tract FA on corpus-callosum FA and MS status, baseline visit, complete cases — the
model of the DTI plasmode dataset — fitted with refund 79a346fb by REML and by curve-blocked NCV.

```{r dti-load}
DTIB <- readr::read_csv("summaries/dti-case/beta-grid.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
DTIG <- readr::read_csv("summaries/dti-case/gamma.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
DTIR <- readr::read_csv("summaries/dti-case/recipes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
DTIF <- readr::read_csv("summaries/dti-case/fits.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
save_tab(DTIR, "dti-recipes")
save_tab(DTIF, "dti-fits")
zq <- qnorm(1 - (1 - LEVEL) / 2)
```

```{r fig-dti-app}
#| fig-cap: "DTI application. Top: REML and NCV estimates of β(s,t). Middle: grid points where the pointwise 95% interval for β excludes zero (REML fit, model-based and CL2). Bottom: the MS effect γ(t) of the REML fit with model-based (grey) and CL2 (blue) pointwise intervals, and the NCV estimate (dashed)."
#| fig-height: 8
lim <- max(abs(DTIB$est)) * c(-1, 1)
p1 <- ggplot(DTIB, aes(s, t, fill = est)) +
  geom_raster() +
  facet_wrap(~fit) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "grey96", high = "#b2182b", midpoint = 0, limits = lim, name = "beta") +
  coord_fixed() + theme_doc + theme(legend.position = "right")
b <- DTIB |> filter(fit == "REML")
ex <- bind_rows(
  b |> mutate(se = "model-based", sig = sign(est) * (abs(est) > zq * se_model)),
  b |> mutate(se = "CL2", sig = sign(est) * (abs(est) > zq * se_cl2))
) |> mutate(sig = factor(sig, c(-1, 0, 1), c("below 0", "contains 0", "above 0")))
p2 <- ggplot(ex, aes(s, t, fill = sig)) +
  geom_raster() +
  facet_wrap(~se) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("below 0" = "#2166ac", "contains 0" = "grey92", "above 0" = "#b2182b"), name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_fixed() + theme_doc + theme(legend.position = "right")
g <- DTIG |> filter(fit == "REML")
p3 <- ggplot(g, aes(t, est)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = est - zq * se_cl2, ymax = est + zq * se_cl2), fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = est - zq * se_model, ymax = est + zq * se_model), fill = "grey40", alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_line(data = DTIG |> filter(fit == "NCV"), linetype = 2) +
  labs(y = "gamma(t), MS effect") + theme_doc
fig <- p1 / p2 / p3 + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 0.8))
save_fig(fig, "dti-application", 6.5, 8)
fig
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dti-app
#| tbl-cap: "DTI application: median half-width and share of the grid where the pointwise 95% interval excludes zero (REML fit), and the median CL2/model-based SE ratio, for β(s,t) and γ(t)."
show(DTIR)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dti-fits
#| tbl-cap: "DTI fits: curves, grid points, total, surface and γ EDF, and the median absolute NCV − REML surface difference in units of REML's CL2 SE."
show(DTIF)
```
